data.name: EngineUnavailable
data.value: Osdrop's engine could not be started. Reinstall Osdrop.

data.name: EngineNewerVersion
data.value: The group was saved by a newer Osdrop. Update Osdrop on this PC.

data.name: GroupEmpty
data.value: Pair with a Mac or PC nearby to start a group.

data.name: GroupRemoved
data.value: Another computer removed this one from the group.

data.name: GroupNearbyNone
data.value: No other Mac or PC running Osdrop was found on this network.

data.name: GroupNeedsUpdate
data.value: Runs another Osdrop version; update both to the same one.

data.name: PairingHint
data.value: Pair only if the other computer shows the same code.

data.name: PairingWaiting
data.value: Waiting for the code to be confirmed on {0}…

data.name: PairingFailedBusy
data.value: The other computer is pairing with another one. Try again in a moment.

data.name: PairingFailedInAnotherGroup
data.value: The two computers are in different groups. One of them must leave its group first.

data.name: PairingFailedUnreachable
data.value: The other computer could not be reached.

data.name: ClipboardUnavailable
data.value: The copy from {0} could not be fetched.

data.name: ClipboardTooLarge
data.value: The copy from {0} is too large for the clipboard; drag it instead.

data.name: ClipboardFetchingHint
data.value: Paste once this is done; until then a paste gives what was copied before.

data.name: ClipboardReady
data.value: The files copied on {0} can be pasted now.

data.name: GroupBlockedHint
data.value: They cannot pair with any computer in the group. Unblock one to pair with it again.

data.name: PairingFailedRefused
data.value: It does not accept pairing with this computer.

data.name: PanelInputElsewhere
data.value: The mouse and keyboard are on {0}.

data.name: PanelInputHere
data.value: The mouse and keyboard are on this computer.

data.name: PanelLockInput
data.value: Keep the cursor where it is ({0})

data.name: ControlHint
data.value: Push the cursor against an edge to move to the computer beside it. {0} brings it back.

data.name: ControlLocked
data.value: The cursor stays on the computer it is on. {0} lets it cross again.

data.name: ControlLost
data.value: {0} stopped answering, so the cursor came back.

data.name: ControlRefusedNotPermitted
data.value: {0} does not accept control from this computer.

data.name: ControlRefusedBusy
data.value: {0} is in use by another computer.

data.name: ServiceNotInstalled
data.value: The Osdrop Input service is not installed, so this PC's mouse and keyboard cannot move to other computers and other computers cannot control this PC. Repair installs it; Windows asks for permission.

data.name: ServiceStopped
data.value: The Osdrop Input service is stopped, so this PC's mouse and keyboard cannot move to other computers and other computers cannot control this PC. Repair starts it; Windows asks for permission.

data.name: ServiceNotAnswering
data.value: The Osdrop Input service is not answering, so this PC's mouse and keyboard cannot move to other computers. It usually recovers within a few seconds; if this stays, repair it.

data.name: ServiceRepairFailed
data.value: The service could not be repaired. Reinstall Osdrop, or open the input service logs in Settings › Advanced.

data.name: UpdatesDaily
data.value: Check for updates once a day

data.name: UpdatesFailed
data.value: The check failed. Try again later.

data.name: SettingsStartWithWindowsFailed
data.value: Windows did not allow starting Osdrop at sign-in.

data.name: SettingsArrangementDescription
data.value: Drag a computer to place it beside another one. The cursor crosses where their edges meet. Every computer in the group gets the new arrangement at once.

data.name: SettingsArrangementEmpty
data.value: The arrangement appears once another computer is in the group.

data.name: SettingsArrangementHint
data.value: Drag a computer to place it beside another one.

data.name: SettingsNameDescription
data.value: The name other computers show. Saving restarts the connections.

data.name: SettingsAllowFiles
data.value: Can send files to this computer

data.name: SettingsAllowClipboard
data.value: Shares the clipboard with this computer

data.name: SettingsImmediate
data.value: Cross as soon as the cursor reaches an edge

data.name: SettingsPush
data.value: Push against an edge for {0} s

data.name: SettingsKeys
data.value: Keys between a Mac and a PC

data.name: SettingsMappingShortcuts
data.value: Shortcuts keep their place (⌘C copies on a PC)

data.name: SettingsMappingPositions
data.value: Every key as it is (⌘ is the Windows key)

data.name: SettingsMappingDescription
data.value: Applies from the next crossing. Between two Macs or two PCs keys never change.

data.name: SettingsLockHotkey
data.value: Keep the cursor where it is: {0}

data.name: SettingsHotkeysDescription
data.value: On a PC these shortcuts are fixed: they use Ctrl, Alt and Windows together, which no app does.

data.name: SettingsShareClipboardDescription
data.value: Copy on one computer and paste on another. Passwords copied from password managers stay on this computer.

data.name: SettingsDiagnosticsCopied
data.value: Copied. Paste it into your report.

data.name: SettingsDiagnosticsDescription
data.value: Versions, settings and the recent log, without names, addresses, keystrokes or clipboard contents.

data.name: ErrorUnsupportedVersion
data.value: The other computer runs another version of Osdrop. Update both to the same version.

data.name: ErrorTooLarge
data.value: It is larger than the limit set in Settings.

data.name: ErrorSecure
data.value: The connection could not be secured. Try again; if it repeats, pair the computers again.

data.name: ErrorTimedOut
data.value: The other computer did not answer in time. Check that it is awake and on the same network.

data.name: ErrorNetwork
data.value: The connection was lost. Check the network on both computers.

data.name: ErrorPeer
data.value: The other computer reported a problem. Update both computers to the latest Osdrop.

data.name: ErrorNotTrusted
data.value: The other computer no longer trusts this one. Pair them again.

data.name: ErrorPeerBusy
data.value: The other computer is busy. Try again in a moment.

data.name: ErrorNotPermitted
data.value: The other computer does not allow this. Its permissions are in its Settings › Devices.

data.name: ErrorGroupFull
data.value: The group is full. Remove a computer before adding another one.

data.name: ErrorInAnotherGroup
data.value: The other computer is in another group. Leave that group on it first.

data.name: ErrorInvalidLayout
data.value: Computers cannot overlap, and each one must touch another one.

data.name: ErrorIoFailure
data.value: A file could not be read or written.

data.name: ErrorNoSpace
data.value: There is not enough free disk space.

data.name: ErrorIntegrityFailed
data.value: The file arrived damaged and was removed. Try again.

data.name: ErrorNotFound
data.value: It is no longer available on the other computer.

data.name: ErrorInternal
data.value: Something went wrong inside Osdrop. Copy diagnostics in Settings › Advanced and report it.
